scope: Advisory magnitude matches between floating Python literals in existing priority package-source candidates and final hash-verified CSV/TSV cells. Source bytes must match the recorded installed asset. This is not an exhaustive fixture or semantic audit. Integer-valued constants, strings, comments, other artifacts and nonpriority files are not covered. A match may be coincidental or unrelated; inspect provenance, methods and inputs. Absence is not answer-isolation approval. The first matching cell is shown and all matching cells are counted.
